_note: With a Svelte 4 install `{#each}` takes an array-like or iterable only: svelte2tsx's `__sveltets_2_ensureArray` widens its parameter to `undefined | null` just when `svelte` exports `mount` (Svelte 5). `items` may be undefined, so TS2345 at the each expression. The `node_modules/svelte` stub carries the part of Svelte 4's types the generated code reaches, without `mount`.
